summary.name: Drag and drop
summary.one_liner: Wikipedia article explaining drag and drop, a pointing-device gesture in graphical user interfaces for moving objects or invoking actions.
keywords: how does drag and drop work
use_cases: Understanding the history of drag and drop in operating systems
Learning HTML5 drag and drop features
Studying usability issues with dragging interfaces
Researching block-based and visual end-user programming
summary.what_it_does: This Wikipedia article describes drag and drop as a GUI gesture: press and hold a button to grab an object, drag it, and release to drop it. It covers usability concerns such as accidental drags, hidden drop targets, and the effort of dragging. It gives historical notes on drag and drop in classic Mac OS, System 7.5, and OS/2's Workplace Shell. It also covers web support (HTML5 text, element, and file dragging), drag-and-drop website builders with a market-share table, touch-screen use on iOS and Android, and examples in end-user programming tools such as AgentSheets and Blender.
notable: Covers the history of drag and drop in Mac OS, System 7.5, and OS/2
Summarises HTML5 drag-and-drop support for text, elements, and files
Includes a market-share table of drag-and-drop website builders as of May 2025
caveats: Describes a general concept, not a single downloadable tool
Website builder statistics are dated (as of May 2025)
